option_relations.rationale: Catastrophic Adult-onset Still Disease (AOSD) with secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis/macrophage activation syndrome (MAS) is a severe form or complication of Adult-onset Still's disease, which is the core of the provided leaf.
Adult-onset Still's disease is the primary diagnosis described in the leaf, which includes systemic inflammatory involvement.
